skill.summary: Provides organized access to Qimao Free Novel's public book categories, membership details, help topics, and official activity information.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of qimao-free-novel skill:

- Registers the “七猫免费小说” (Qimao Free Novel) skill for organizing information from public sections of the site.
- Focuses on book library categories, rankings, membership details, help center, and official activity pages.
- Explicitly excludes piracy, account sharing, API calls, or handling private user/account data.
- Gathers and summarizes member benefits, device support, download limits, FAQs, and copyright info.
- Designed for automation with context-sensitive notes on regional and temporal differences in content.
